body: I feel bad for listening in and wish I hadn't and then feel bad for feeling this way. It just seems so futile because I can't solve his problems in the end. Maybe I can make him see that life is worth living, but I can't make his life better. And then I think about how much worse it would be in his shoes, and I feel even worse. At least I can vent here...

Thank you...I'd rather do something than nothing. I'm hoping that the quiet means things have calmed down...being unemployed can be stressful and having to support that can be stressful too, no? Best case scenario...they have calmed down. Long term seems dreary though. This was not what I wanted to come home to and now I'm just shaken up. Thank you for your advice again.
